about: Curated license texts for files bundled into the desktop release that
neither an installed Python distribution nor the build system's package
manager (dpkg, Homebrew) owns, such as the DLLs the python.org Windows
build ships next to the interpreter. Each entry lists the file name
patterns it covers (case-insensitive) and ships the component's own
license text from packaging/licenses/; 'source' says where that text
comes from. A bundled file that nothing covers stops the build.

components.name: Microsoft Visual C++ runtime
